notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Good day to all brothers and sisters in arms. ⚔

New Year holidays are coming to an end 🎊 , and with it the day of release ⚠ of our wonderful game is coming, so we are pleased to present you new completely redesigned starter characters.🆕

Under your expert guidance, these dodgers can become legends of the battlefields. 😎

Happy New Year to all!!!
Play good games🤠

notes.title: Training mode update
notes.content: In the near future, players will receive an update in which the fully redesigned training mode will be available, characters in the training will receive additional animation. In training mode, the construction and holding of the attacking waves will be available. You need to build a defense to contain the attacking forces of the enemy. The animation process can be viewed on our youtube channel.
